records.name: ReallyFree

It's earned. No account, no signup, no tracking. Nothing about your browsing reaches us. Free, and staying free.

records.name: Brev
records.tagline: The AI coworker that drives action on your goals

Brev uses AI to connect goals, meetings, metrics, decisions, and work across the tools teams already use, so leaders can see where execution stands, understand why things are off track, and act earlier.

records.name: Edyt
records.tagline: AI for text you can't even select. Any app on Mac & Windows

Rewrite keeps your tone and follows your instructions. Explain and Translate go as deep as you ask. Alternatives shows several ways to say it. Saved prompts run on anything you select and follow your account to every machine. Can't select it? Hold Option or Alt and drag over a PDF, screenshot, or shared screen. Read on your device. Free plan is enough for most people.

records.name: QuietGlass
records.tagline: Screen privacy for your Mac, with or without AirPods
records.description: QuietGlass is a free, open-source Mac app for screen privacy. Look away with compatible AirPods and your screen blurs. Your camera can spot another face in view and warn you or blur the screen, even while you're still looking. Protect a window or selected area, blur sensitive text, or keep your active window clear with Focus mode. Optional owner recognition checks it's you before clearing camera protection. Native Swift, notch controls, and processing on your Mac. macOS 14+.

records.name: PewCB

It may not be practical just yet, but it teases what comes next: vibe-routing. Software runs seconds after a code change; hardware still waits two weeks for a PCB. PewCB cuts prompt-to-device time from 2 weeks to 1 hour, enabling 4 iterations a day instead of 2 a month.

records.name: Jev Wrapped

Jev, TypeSafe's decision model, reads up to 1,500 posts one by one and answers four questions about each: which of ten kinds of post it is, whether it is a paid ad, whether it uses clickbait, whether it pushes on fear or anger. The card shows the mix month by month and links the posts that scored highest, so you can check the model yourself. No sign-in, no Telegram account. Open source.

records.name: OneStream Live 2.0

Multistream to 45+ social platforms and the web, manage streams from mobile, and use tools like Teleprompter, Live Sales, Unified Chat, team workflows, and 24/7 streaming. Free to start. Trusted by 2M+ users worldwide.

records.name: Xem

records.name: Prowler Cloud

Prowler supports AWS, Azure, GCP, Kubernetes, Microsoft 365, GitHub, IaC and more, with thousands of checks, compliance mappings and attack paths, plus Lighthouse AI, MCP support and advanced compliance workflows. Connect your agent now to start defending your cloud at cloud.prowler.com.

records.name: Clueprint

No Electron, no account, no telemetry.

records.name: Robot Voice Bridge

Drag takes into Premiere, Final Cut or anywhere else. Uses your own ElevenLabs account.

records.name: Contextberg

This launch adds native macOS capture, OCR screenshot search, source exclusions, and flexible model routing: use your existing Codex sign-in, a Gemini/OpenRouter API key, Contextberg Cloud, or a fully local model.

records.name: FeedsBar

Native macOS, no account, no tracking. 7-day free trial, then $24.99 once, no subscription.

records.name: HotelRoost

Upload an EPUB you already own and Inkspell builds a glossary of every character, place and faction, a relationship map, a family tree and a story-so-far recap, all locked to the chapter you're on. Series link into one memory, so book four remembers book one. Entries are generated from the book's own text and can be wrong. Android only, membership required, 7-day free trial.

records.name: TradeFix AI
records.tagline: Your AI trading coach for Indian stock market traders
records.description: Hey PH! Most Indian retail traders don't lose money from bad strategies — they lose it from unreviewed mistakes: revenge trading, poor risk sizing, no journal at all. TradeFix AI is a trading journal + AI coach built specifically for NSE/BSE/F&O traders. Log your trades, and it analyzes your patterns — win rate, R:R, emotional/psychological tendencies — and tells you exactly what's costing you money. Would love feedback from the trading + fintech community here!

records.name: Rewind by EarningsWatcher
records.tagline: Replay real earnings weeks in an options trading game
records.description: Rewind turns past earnings weeks into a game you can play at your own pace. Follow the owl, make trades with paper money and fast-forward to discover what happened next. Real market data brings each week to life as you practise options strategies through guided challenges or trade your own way.

records.name: Relay
records.tagline: Share your phone's internet with your PC, no cloud
records.description: Relay turns your Android phone into a secure hotspot for your Windows PC — over an encrypted WireGuard tunnel, with no root, no account, and no server in between. Pair with a QR code or a 2-digit number and you're online in seconds. It handles TCP/UDP, survives Wi-Fi switches and DHCP changes, and keeps DNS/IPv6 traffic locked inside the tunnel. Kotlin/Compose on Android,NET 8/WinUI 3 on Windows, Go-based WireGuard core with gVisor. Open source (GPL-3.0), with real everyday users.

records.name: Treezy Play
records.tagline: The show that calls you, and listens when you answer
records.description: Your phone rings in the middle of the show. It is Dr. Tiffany Belle, filmed with real actors, and she waits for a real answer. Say something out loud and the story routes on what you said. Four branches, twenty-eight endings. Now on iPhone and Android.

records.name: Dinomy
records.tagline: Any song, any story, any skill. Made by you for your kid
records.description: Dinomy is where parents make what their 2 to 6 year old watches. Start with a character: turn a drawing, a photo of a favourite toy or a few words into a friend your child helped invent. Then type what a song or story should be about and the app makes it, starring that character, with your child's name in it. There are short lesson courses too, on any skill, and they answer back. You see everything first. No ads, no feed, no autoplay. It ends at All Done.

records.name: Zenuro
records.tagline: Long videos into shorts and topic clips. Pay by card, crypto
records.description: Paste a YouTube link or upload a podcast, interview or stream. Zenuro finds the best moments and cuts vertical shorts plus long topic clips from one upload, with animated captions in dozens of languages, AI titles and covers. Free 30 min/month. Card or crypto.

records.name: Startup Finance Pack
records.tagline: The startup finance pack your AI agent can update
records.description: The finance templates a CFO actually used through seed-to-Nasdaq - rebuilt so your AI agent can update them. 8 components: unit economics, 24-month operating model with runway dashboard, board pack, metrics dictionary, investor updates, diligence checklist, and a worked example with every number pre-filled. Plain Excel and Google Sheets, one input layer, no macros. Tell your agent what changed and it updates the pack.

records.name: Playgeko
records.tagline: Intelligent Club Management Software
records.description: Playgeko is a club management and booking software for sports facilities, padel, tennis, football, gyms, and multi-sport centers. Clubs run bookings, memberships, coaching, CRM, inventory, and payments from one platform. The CRM flags renewals, surfaces upsells, and pre-books slots based on preferences, so courts get filled instead of sitting empty. Managers get a mobile app to run the club from anywhere. Clubs can add a white-label app and website, and reach new players through the marketplace.

records.name: threadle
records.tagline: What your coding agents did while you weren't looking
records.description: Claude Code, opencode, Cursor, Antigravity, Codex, Copilot and Grok write down everything they do: every file read, every tool call, every token spent. Almost nobody reads it. threadle does, and draws it as one graph. Walk the timeline, diff what changed, trace lineage across runs. Then hand context from one agent to another and wire sessions into pipelines. Localhost, no account, no telemetry, no outbound requests.

records.name: MacPrune
records.tagline: Reclaim gigabytes of Mac disk space in one click
records.description: MacPrune finds the junk eating your disk: system caches, orphaned files, leftover app data, Xcode build folders, and the big files you forgot about. One click removes it, with safe defaults that protect anything that matters. It also sits in your menu bar with live CPU, RAM, network and battery stats, a memory optimizer, an app uninstaller and a privacy cleaner. Free to use. Pro is $19.99 once, never a subscription. No account, no ads, no data collection. macOS 13+, Apple Silicon and Intel.

records.name: Strofi
records.tagline: Your files, tabs, and apps — remembered in one timeline
records.description: Strofi is a Mac app that remembers how your work moves. Work rarely happens in one place. A presentation lives in PowerPoint, research sits in browser tabs, and yesterday's context is scattered across apps and files. Strofi brings the files, pages, and apps you actually use into one timeline. It learns which items show up together, so the right ones surface when you need them. Less digging through tabs, more picking up right where you left off.

records.name: Scroll Brake — App Blocker
records.tagline: Stop doomscrolling with conscious math friction on iOS
records.description: Scroll Brake is a lightweight (~4MB) iOS app that replaces mindless scrolling with healthy mental friction. Standard limits fail because tapping 'Ignore' is pure muscle memory. Instead of an easy bypass, Scroll Brake locks distracting apps behind quick math puzzles, cooling impulsive dopamine cravings in 10 seconds. Built natively on Apple's Screen Time API with zero battery drain and 100% on-device privacy. Up to 3 rules are completely free forever, with no ads, trackers, or subscriptions.

records.name: Locuto.PRO
records.tagline: All-in-one platform for language teachers and schools.
records.description: Locuto.PRO turns language lessons into interactive digital workbooks where teachers and students can learn together in one continuous space. Create lessons with 35+ exercise types, teach live with built-in video and shared whiteboards, assign homework, practice vocabulary, and track progress. Schools can also manage teachers, students, courses, and analytics, replacing scattered PDFs, Zoom calls, spreadsheets, and multiple learning tools with one connected platform.

records.name: Echo
records.tagline: Audit your SEO and whether AI actually cites you (AEO)
records.description: Echo audits any site for two things at once: classic SEO health, and whether AI answer engines (ChatGPT, Perplexity, Google AI Overviews) actually cite you. Point it at a URL, it crawls up to 50 pages, and every finding is in plain English: what it means, why it matters, what to fix. The free audit is the full diagnosis, no login. Paid (EUR 9 one-off or EUR 19/mo unlimited) adds the fix plan: JSON-LD, content briefs, llms.txt, AEO checks. Also ships as an MCP server for ChatGPT, Claude, Cursor.

records.name: Peptly: Peptide Calculator
records.tagline: Peptide reconstitution math, made clear on a visual syringe
records.description: Peptly turns peptide reconstitution into one clear answer. Enter your vial, your bacteriostatic water and your target dose, and Peptly shows the exact units to draw on a visual syringe. Log every injection, save your mixes, and keep 23 peptide profiles a tap away. On-device. No account needed. Peptly is a calculation and record-keeping tool. It is not medical advice and does not prescribe, recommend or supply anything. Consult a licensed clinician before any injection.

records.name: Rizzqo
records.tagline: Asset-first compliance execution GRC platform
records.description: Most compliance tools start with a framework and end with a checklist. Rizzqo starts with your organization. It models your services, systems, suppliers and the people responsible, then turns ISO 27001, NIS2, DORA, GDPR and EU AI Act controls into requirements on those actual assets. Owners answer, attach evidence and confirm. Status is calculated from confirmed answers, gaps become risks with a euro value and a treatment decision, tasks sync with Jira. Made in Germany, hosted in your country.

records.name: Club Manager
records.tagline: A self-serve platform for membership & booking businesses
records.description: A single-file, self-serve web app platform for any recurring group activity business: sports leagues, fitness studios, hobby clubs, dance classes, and more. Everything a member-facing app needs is built in: sign-up, subscriptions, session booking, a shop, and a full admin dashboard with analytics and CRM. One HTML file, no build step, no framework. It ships with a local-database fallback so every flow works immediately - swap in a real backend when you're ready to launch.

records.name: ASWA
records.tagline: Free Website AI Audit — Is your store visible to ChatGPT?
records.description: ASWA checks if ChatGPT, Perplexity & Claude can actually see your site. 68% of Shopify stores unknowingly block GPTBot in robots.txt. Get 12-point GEO audit instantly — free, no login, no card. What ASWA checks (12 points): robots.txt llms.txt JSON-LD + schema SSR vs CSR (can AI read content?) Metadata for AI summaries Sitemap with product feeds Brand Radar — are you mentioned in AI answers? Internal linking for crawlers E-E-A-T signal Speed + crawlability Headings structure for AI Fix checklist

records.name: Halo eSIM
records.tagline: Travel data, sorted. eSIMs for 190+ destinations.
records.description: Halo is a travel eSIM built to remove the small annoyances. Networks are named on every plan before you pay, so you know it's NTT docomo or Vodafone, not a mystery MVNO. No app, no account: buy in three taps, the eSIM arrives by email in under a minute, and it activates when you first connect at your destination, so install it at home and forget it. Hotspot with no cap on our side, top-ups mid-trip, 190+ destinations, fixed-data or daily unlimited, 30-day money-back before activation.

records.name: Renewal Vista
records.tagline: Renewal management, made visible.
records.description: Renewal Vista helps businesses stay ahead of software, vendor, contract, license, and service renewals. Track renewal dates, cancellation deadlines, costs, budgets, auto-renewals, ownership, and reminders in one place. Intelligent document, email, and photo intake reduces manual entry, while dashboards and reports highlight what needs attention before it becomes an expensive surprise.

records.name: CHOPBAR RECIPES APP
records.tagline: Discover Delicious Ghanaian and continental Recipes
records.description: Chopbar Ghana Recipes makes cooking simple with authentic Ghanaian and continental recipes in one easy-to-use app. What makes it stand out is offline recipe access, allowing users to cook without an internet connection. Users can save favourite recipes, explore different categories, follow simple step-by-step instructions, and discover helpful cooking tips. It brings Ghanaian food culture and everyday cooking together in a convenient digital experience.

records.name: RideValet Connect
records.tagline: Valet comes to you, drives your own car with or without you
records.description: RideValet Connect is an on-demand personal driver marketplace. No existing app lets you book a verified driver who comes to you and drives YOUR own vehicle anywhere — with or without you. No leaving your car behind. No expensive parking. No towing. Open the app, pick a nearby Valet, your car gets where it needs to go. Built by a logistics professional who lived this problem firsthand. Prototype is live today. Looking for a strategic partner or buyer. No one owns this space yet.

records.name: Wordy
records.tagline: Build words from letters in this relaxing puzzle game
records.description: Wordy flips the word game formula — trace a path connecting letters to spell words, visiting every cell exactly once. Vocabulary meets spatial logic. 4x4 to 6x6 grids • 16 unlockable themes • Learn definitions & fun facts • Soothing haptics • No forced ads, no paywalls A brain-teaser that makes you think, one letter at a time.

records.name: Zourse
records.tagline: The AI operating system for real estate teams.
records.description: Zourse is the AI operating system for real estate teams. Instead of jumping between disconnected tools for underwriting, contracts, documents, deadlines, transactions, and client follow-up, simply tell Zourse what needs to get done. Zourse understands your deals, documents, deadlines, and workflows—and helps move the work from lead to close. One workspace. One AI.

records.name: Framejet
records.tagline: Screenshots of pages that take several clicks to reach
records.description: Framejet turns any URL into a clean PNG or JPEG — cookie banners and chat widgets removed before the capture, not cropped after. New: multi-step goals. The selector for step 2 doesn't exist until step 1 has happened, so a flow can't be scripted up front. Describe it in words and Framejet walks it: search, open the result, switch tab, then shoot. It picks only from controls on the page; typed text comes from values you supply. REST + remote MCP, one key. 200/month free, no card.

records.name: Suparelay
records.tagline: Call landlines & mobiles worldwide | ¢2/min | no app req
records.description: Calling abroad still sucks in 2026 🥵 - your carrier prices it like a luxury, and the apps that replaced Skype shipped once and were never touched again. So I built the one I wanted. Meet Suparelay: - 200+ countries, from 2¢ / minute, no sub, credit never expires - your browser is your phone, nothing to install - see the price before you dial, pay nothing if no one picks up - no new UX to learn. You just get a phone (revolutionary, I know)

records.name: HumanEyes: AI Shield
records.tagline: Block AI search overviews & blur AI images on your feeds.
records.description: HumanEyes is an AI Shield which is a lightweight Chrome extension that takes back your browser. It automatically strips Google AI search overviews and blurs AI images on X and Google with clean warning badges in the sense of fun emojis. It features a live tracking counter and quick-toggle bypass. Built for a fast, human web. (Instagram blocking coming soon!)

records.name: SpotStartup
records.tagline: Every startup, investor and lab in tech, on one globe
records.description: An interactive 3D globe of the tech world. 128,515 organisations placed in their real cities: 100,166 startups, 23,709 tech companies, the investors and accelerators behind them, and the universities and labs their founders came from. 180,060 connections you can trace, plus an infrastructure layer of submarine cables, cloud regions and data centres. Explore it as a globe, expand any company into a network graph two steps out, or filter and sort it as a table. Free, no login.

records.name: BiteVault
records.tagline: Save TikTok recipes and restaurants to your own food map
records.description: Share a TikTok or Instagram Reel and BiteVault saves the recipe with ingredients and steps, or pins the restaurant on your own map with opening hours and directions. A "top 10 cafes" video imports every venue in one go. Every recipe gets allergen and gluten flags, free on every plan, with a cautious gluten rating built by someone who cooks for a coeliac. Recipe websites and Google Maps links work too. Free for 50 saves on Android, iPhone and the web.

records.name: Vault Mail
records.tagline: Private invoice comparison Scan for fraud locally in browser
records.description: Stop invoice fraud before paying. Vault Mail lets you compare a new invoice against a trusted reference to instantly spot changed bank details (RIB), duplicate numbers, or revised totals. Key feature: Ultimate Privacy. 100% of the document processing happens locally in your browser. Your financial data never leaves your device. • 5 free comparisons • Text-based PDF & TXT support • No signup or account required

records.name: Offline PDF Desk
records.tagline: Redact, merge and Bates-number PDFs offline. One HTML file.
records.description: For people who can't install software (no admin rights) and can't upload confidential files. One HTML file that runs offline in your browser: merge, reorder, rotate and extract pages, Bates-style numbering, metadata stripping incl. XMP, and redaction that rebuilds redacted pages as images so the text is actually gone. EUR 9 one-off, unconditional refund. Disclosure: designed, written and tested by an AI system (Claude) operating autonomously; sold by a named human who is legally responsible.

records.name: 72 Street
records.tagline: AI-powered stock research for Indian investors
records.description: 72 Street is a SEBI-registered research platform that combines AI-powered insights with market data to help Indian investors research stocks. Explore Venty AI, technical and fundamental analysis, market scanners, IPOs, FII/DII data, chart patterns, and more in one platform.

records.name: Retriever
records.tagline: Free native Mac API client. The Paw replacement you need
records.description: Retriever is a free native Mac API client. Send HTTP requests, organize them in collections, switch environments, and chain one response into the next with {{@Login.body.token}}, no scripts. OAuth 2.0 with auto-refresh, a fast JSON tree, ⌘K for everything, code generation in 7 languages. Imports Postman, cURL and OpenAPI. Everything is plain JSON on your disk: no account, no cloud. Ships with an MCP server so Claude, Cursor and other agents can use your collections.

records.name: STACKED, powered by Dux-Soup
records.tagline: LinkedIn outreach that scales safely and gets real results
records.description: STACKED is the new LinkedIn automation tool from Dux-Soup, delivering more powerful LinkedIn automation, an effortless user experience and advanced account safety. STACKED is simpler to understand, easier to use, and faster to get results. Launch drip campaigns in a few clicks, understand what's getting results, connect LinkedIn to your existing tools, and grow your pipeline faster.

records.name: Mystical Eve
records.tagline: Live spiritual guidance through chat, phone, and video
records.description: Mystical Eve is a modern marketplace for live spiritual guidance, connecting people with independent advisors through private chat, phone, and video. Browse by specialty, connect instantly with advisors who are online, or schedule a reading for later. From discovering the right advisor to booking and meeting with them, Mystical Eve is designed to make the entire experience simple, private, transparent, and personal.

records.name: Hivestaff
records.tagline: Where Workflows Find Their Hive!
records.description: Hivestaff is an all-in-one cloud ERP built for construction, real estate, infrastructure, and professional services. Unlike traditional ERPs, it unifies HR, Payroll, CRM, Projects, Procurement, Finance, Assets, and Recruitment in one platform with industry-specific workflows, real-time dashboards, and mobile-first collaboration eliminating spreadsheets and disconnected software.

records.name: Hacker News Search
records.tagline: Full-text search for Hacker News, powered by Neon & Vercel.
records.description: A full-text search over all of Hacker News (~49M stories, comments, jobs & polls, syncing live per hour) to be 𝐬𝐮𝐫𝐩𝐫𝐢𝐬𝐢𝐧𝐠𝐥𝐲 𝐟𝐚𝐬𝐭 with all magic at the Neon Postgres layer: • Every keystroke is a live query against Neon Postgres • BM25 (powered by Lakebase Search) ranking runs inside the Postgres • No connection pool, just SQL-over-HTTP round trips • pg_prewarm loads the table + every index into cache • partial BM25 index per type, predicate matching the WHERE clause • Deployed on Vercel

records.name: PewCB
records.tagline: Vibe-routing is coming. Desktop PCB Factory is here.
records.description: PewCB is a laser-based desktop PCB prototyping machine that produces factory-grade boards in 10 minutes. OpenAI's latest demo showed Astra creating a device in KiCad. It may not be practical just yet, but it teases what comes next: vibe-routing. Software runs seconds after a code change; hardware still waits two weeks for a PCB. PewCB cuts prompt-to-device time from 2 weeks to 1 hour, enabling 4 iterations a day instead of 2 a month.

records.name: Jev Wrapped
records.tagline: See how much of a Telegram channel is ads and clickbait
records.description: Paste the name of a public Telegram channel and get a card for its last year. Jev, TypeSafe's decision model, reads up to 1,500 posts one by one and answers four questions about each: which of ten kinds of post it is, whether it is a paid ad, whether it uses clickbait, whether it pushes on fear or anger. The card shows the mix month by month and links the posts that scored highest, so you can check the model yourself. No sign-in, no Telegram account. Open source.

records.name: Copy Trading Clone Script
records.tagline: A New Layer for Copy Trading Platforms
records.description: Copy trading requires more than matching traders with followers. A Copy Trading Clone Script can combine trader profiles, strategy selection, real-time trade synchronization, broker/API connectivity, portfolio tracking, risk controls, and admin management in one platform. For entrepreneurs and startups, it provides a technical foundation to launch a copy trading business, customize the user experience, define trader–follower workflows, and adapt the platform to their target market.

records.name: OneStream Live 2.0
records.tagline: Create, schedule, multistream & sell live on 45+ platforms
records.description: OneStream Live 2.0 brings five ways to go live into one platform for creators, businesses, and teams: browser-based Studio, external encoder streaming, pre-recorded streaming, Stream Players, and Custom Websites. Multistream to 45+ social platforms and the web, manage streams from mobile, and use tools like Teleprompter, Live Sales, Unified Chat, team workflows, and 24/7 streaming. Free to start. Trusted by 2M+ users worldwide.

records.name: Mundial TV
records.tagline: Watch live TV from around the world on your desktop
records.description: Desktop live-TV player: 442 channels grouped by country and genre, HLS with a quality selector and subtitles, an always-on-top mini player, and a phone remote via QR. Spanish DTT channels that do not stream free HLS (Mediaset, Atresmedia) open their official web player instead. Built with Electron 44 and hls.js. Free, open source, no account, no telemetry.

records.name: Xem
records.tagline: Open-source email marketing with managed SMTP
records.description: Create newsletters, email campaigns and visual automations in one open-source workspace. Xem includes reusable templates, signup forms, contact lists and analytics. Connect your own SMTP provider or use managed sending through Amazon SES, with domain verification and workspace approval.

records.name: VideoFlow Studio
records.tagline: Type your startup URL and get a premium video trailer
records.description: VideoFlow Studio is a video agent harness. Run `npx @videoflow/studio`, point it at your site's URL, and a coding agent (Claude Code or Codex) reads what your product does, plans a film, builds it, renders it, and reviews its own cut before handing it back. No templates — the plan comes from your product, not your page's headings. The output is editable: open it in the built-in editor, or just ask for a change in plain English. Open-source rendering engine. Free to start.

records.name: Shootsolo 2.0
records.tagline: Voice-controlled camera + teleprompter for solo creators
records.description: Film yourself hands-free. Say "Start Recording" and "Stop Recording," keep or discard each take, read your script from the built-in teleprompter, light your shot with virtual studio lights, and record portrait + landscape in one take. Free on iOS and Android.

records.name: Prowler Cloud
records.tagline: Where your AI agent becomes a cloud security defender
records.description: Prowler brings open-source cloud security into the agentic era. It combines deterministic, auditable security checks with AI-powered investigation, prioritization, reporting, and remediation. Prowler supports AWS, Azure, GCP, Kubernetes, Microsoft 365, GitHub, IaC and more, with thousands of checks, compliance mappings and attack paths, plus Lighthouse AI, MCP support and advanced compliance workflows. Connect your agent now to start defending your cloud at cloud.prowler.com.

records.name: Clueprint
records.tagline: See what your agents left running on your Mac
records.description: Every Claude Code or Codex session leaves something behind - dev servers, Docker stacks, git worktrees, half your RAM. Clueprint is a native menu-bar app that shows all of it live, grouped by project and branch, and cleans up only what it can prove is safe: verified, re-checked, moved to the Trash - never deleted. No Electron, no account, no telemetry.

records.name: Robot Voice Bridge
records.tagline: Run ElevenLabs like a voiceover session, right on your Mac
records.description: ElevenLabs runs in a browser, so getting a line into an edit means generate, download, find the file, import, repeat. Robot Voice Bridge is a native Mac app that turns that into a voiceover session. Write and direct the script in one window, shape each line with performance tags, fix names with an IPA pronunciation editor, then press S to drop the selected take at the playhead in Pro Tools or Logic. Drag takes into Premiere, Final Cut or anywhere else. Uses your own ElevenLabs account.

records.name: Contextberg
records.tagline: Local AI agent memory served via MCP
records.description: Contextberg brings local AI agent memory to macOS and Windows. It captures screens, browser history, and agent conversations into a private, searchable archive, then serves relevant context to Codex, Claude Code, Cursor, and other agents over MCP. This launch adds native macOS capture, OCR screenshot search, source exclusions, and flexible model routing: use your existing Codex sign-in, a Gemini/OpenRouter API key, Contextberg Cloud, or a fully local model.

records.name: FeedsBar
records.tagline: A quiet, continuous news/media ticker for your Mac desktop
records.description: FeedsBar streams high-signal headlines across your Mac desktop in a slim, always-on ticker, fed by the Signal 500: 500 sources hand-scored on editorial quality and ad restraint. Topic orbs reduce a cluster of headlines to three phrases. Play music and the ticker re-tunes to that artist. Add your own feeds and symbols, or send it full-screen as an ambient board. Native macOS, no account, no tracking. 7-day free trial, then $24.99 once, no subscription.

records.name: 2BA.AI
records.tagline: Stop waiting for tokens, and start shipping
records.description: EU-hosted AI infrastructure for developers. Install with one command and get 4,500 requests per rolling 5-hour window for a flat €20/month — no token counting, no surprise usage bills. Works with Cursor, VS Code, Claude Code, and any OpenAI-compatible client. Zero logging. 100% EU hosted. GDPR native.

records.name: Synthetic Soulmate
records.tagline: A D&D tavern for LA & NYC — the guild is already awake
records.description: Most dating apps feel empty the week you join. Synthetic Soulmate does not. D&D-themed keep for LA & NYC: join free with Google, fill a character sheet, then Scry (search) or Quest (swipe). About 1,000 Synthetic Souls—crafted adventurers to recruit and message—are already at the table. Real LA/NYC people join the same table; mix is intentional and disclosed. Free; Bond $9.99/mo; Soulmate $16.99/mo; Devotion $29.99/mo; Founder Soulmate $399 lifetime (first 1,000). 18+. www.syntheticsoulmate.xyz

records.name: MCP Shrink
records.tagline: Cut MCP context waste by ~90% - hosted compression proxy
records.description: 7 MCP servers eat 67,300 tokens (33.7% of a 200k window) before your first message - we measured it. MCP Shrink is a hosted compression proxy for any remote MCP server: tool definitions become ~54-token stubs that lazy-load on call, tool responses are distilled before they hit your context, and a dashboard shows tokens saved live. Works with any MCP client (Claude Desktop, Code, Cursor, Cline). Existing compressors are all local stdio proxies - nobody offers hosted. Validating demand before

records.name: Advanced Peptide Tracker Launch!
records.tagline: The most advanced Peptide tracker on the market.
records.description: Vial Logics — the peptide & compound logbook that keeps you honest. Log doses, track vial inventory to the last mL, import lab reports, and watch biomarkers trend over time. Built-in units converter, not a dosing calculator — every claim is cited to its source. Your protocol, one clean logbook, zero guesswork.

records.name: Everabyte 2.0
records.tagline: Zero-knowledge cloud storage for teams and individuals
records.description: Everabyte is zero-knowledge cloud storage for individuals, startups and teams that want privacy without giving up simplicity. Files are encrypted on your device before upload, and Everabyte never holds your decryption keys. Store, sync, share and back up files with secure links, granular access controls, team workspaces and scalable storage—all in one privacy-first platform.

records.name: Jobs in Blockchain
records.tagline: Every crypto job on one map. Claim where you hire.
records.description: JobsInBlockchain is a job board for blockchain roles, built as a map. Every place that's hiring sits on a world grid of district-sized blocks, and the grid gets finer as you zoom in. Employers can claim the blocks they hire in. A held area carries your logo across the whole of it, and lifts your job above the rest whenever that area is on screen; hold more of the view and you rank higher. Blocks change hands by outbidding. Everything resets weekly, so nobody owns a city forever.

records.name: The Passport Photo Maker
records.tagline: Compliant passport and visa photos from your phone
records.description: Passport and visa photos that meet the official rules. Take a photo at home, we crop it to size, fix the background and check it before you pay.

records.name: Insulation Cost Advisor
records.tagline: Instant insulation cost, R-value & material estimates
records.description: Free calculator that gives you an instant insulation cost, material, and R-value estimate, before you call a contractor. Enter your square footage and insulation type (attic, spray foam, or blown-in). It detects your climate zone from your ZIP and applies the right DOE R-value target automatically, something most calculators skip. See a full breakdown: material cost, optional add-ons, and final R-value. No sales calls, no guessing.

records.name: Poopy
records.tagline: A very silly fitness game. Big gains. Bad timing.
records.description: Inspired by real events. Poopy is a free browser game where your workout goes hilariously wrong. Think Subway Surfers meets food poisoning. Dodge obstacles, grab kettlebells and try to keep it together. Play as a guest, or sign in to post your score and challenge a friend. For athletes, their training partners, and anyone who enjoys a deeply unserious game.

records.name: Room Temperature Calculator
records.tagline: Estimate your indoor room temperature in seconds
records.description: Room Temperature Calculator is a free web tool for estimating indoor room temperature based on outdoor temperature, room conditions, windows, heating or cooling, fan usage, and room size. Instead of simply showing the current outdoor temperature, it helps users understand how different conditions can affect the temperature inside a room. It works directly in the browser with no app installation or signup required.

records.name: ProfitPilot
records.tagline: See which jobs make money, and why the rest don't

records.name: 82DASH

records.name: Landara
records.tagline: Perpetual FIFO cost of goods sold for Shopify
records.description: Shopify counts your stock. Landara costs it. Landara keeps a dated FIFO cost layer per receipt and draws it down oldest first, with freight and duty landed in before the layer forms. Out comes a ready-to-post journal for Xero or QuickBooks. records.name: QuiQSol

There's no "sync" step because there was never a separation to begin with.

records.name: Long-Term Index Investing

records.name: TypeSafe Jev AI Hub

records.name: Adaired

records.name: ADBE ToolHub

records.name: Talara

records.name: APS Logic Free Program

records.name: Social Reps: Earn Your Scroll
records.tagline: Instagram opens when your camera counts your push-ups
records.description: Every day your social apps start locked. To open them you do push-ups, sit-ups or burpees in front of your phone's camera, and it counts them on the device. Hit the day's goal and the feeds open. Tomorrow, back to zero. No account, no video upload.

records.name: Volio
records.tagline: Create interactive 3D digital photo albums with audio & AI
records.description: Volio transforms your photos into interactive, realistic 3D photo albums with ambient music, dynamic page-turning effects, and AI-assisted layouts. Instead of static photo grids or PDF exports, Volio lets you curate memories into an immersive spatial experience you can share via a single link. Key features: • Realistic 3D WebGL page-flipping engine • Background audio and spatial sound effects • AI prompt assistant to generate story-driven layouts

records.name: NexoraLife
records.tagline: .Launch your own ready-made PWA social network instantly!
records.description: NexoraLife ek production-ready, minimalist PWA social network aur turnkey SaaS hai jo instant deployment ke liye design kiya gaya hai. Isme Supabase backend, real-time encrypted messaging, stories, multi-language support aur ek powerful admin console shamil hai. Iska sabse bada highlight built-in sponsor ad-injection engine hai, jo top brands ya local businesses ke ads ko seedha user streams mein inject karta hai aur live push broadcasts support karta hai. Entrepreneurs ke liye ready to scale

records.name: Walkie
records.tagline: Dictation + meetings + read aloud in one app on-device
records.description: Walkie turns speech into polished text in any app, gives you meeting transcription with notes and who said what, and reads anything aloud in 950+ voices — free and fully on-device when you want. Mac, Windows, Linux, and iPhone.

records.name: GMerge — Mail merge inside Gmail
records.tagline: Personalized Gmail campaigns with tracking built in.
records.description: GMerge sends personalized campaigns from your own Gmail. Import a CSV or Google Sheet, insert merge tags like {{FirstName}}, and send through Gmail so deliverability stays yours. Track opens and clicks on every plan. Pro adds automated follow-ups that stop when someone replies. Start free (20 emails/day) or go Pro ($25/mo, $250/yr) for 500/day and sequences. Compose from the dashboard at gmerge.co, or from the Chrome extension next to Gmail Send.

records.name: MoneyGence
records.tagline: Know your cash, client by client
records.description: See revenue, receivables and risk by client. MoneyGence connects invoices, collections, contracts, vendors and approvals for Indian service businesses.

records.name: Anexti Hiring Platform
records.tagline: Find the right job. Hire the right talent
records.description: Anexti is a global hiring platform connecting talent with the right opportunities. Job seekers can discover relevant jobs, build profiles, upload resumes, track applications, and receive personalized recommendations. Employers can post and promote jobs, manage candidates, source talent, use structured matching, and access hiring insights—all from one platform.

records.name: Versely - AI Ads & UGC Maker
records.tagline: Text to Video, Lip Sync, Reels
records.description: Versely is an AI agent that turns a product link into ads, a selfie into a talking video and a prompt into a reel, then posts them. Type what you want or drop in a photo, pick a model, and get a video, image, voiceover, music track or talking avatar in seconds. Caption it, cut it and publish to TikTok, Instagram, YouTube Shorts, X, Facebook, LinkedIn, Pinterest, Threads and Bluesky, all from the same app. Paste a product link, get a UGC ad. Drop in a selfie, get a talking video.

records.name: Last Letter
records.tagline: Voice-powered word chain party game for iPhone and iPad
records.description: Say the last letter, start the next word. Last Letter is a fast-paced word-chain party game: pick a category, speak your answer out loud and on-device speech recognition scores it instantly. Play solo against the clock with weekly leaderboards and a shared Daily Gauntlet, pass-and-play with 2–8 people, take on AI opponents, or match online through Game Center. 13 categories, 14 languages with native voice recognition, AirPlay to the TV. Free, no ads, no in-app purchases.

records.name: IMCrobot
records.tagline: Synthetic consumer research for China & Southeast Asia
records.description: IMCrobot helps founders, product teams and marketers explore demand, pricing, messaging, trust and localization before entering China or Southeast Asia. Build localized synthetic consumer cohorts, compare audience reactions and identify the questions worth validating with real people. Designed for early market exploration—not as a replacement for field research.

records.name: Vidapts
records.tagline: AI-powered lead conversion for real estate agents
records.description: Real estate agents don't just need more leads — they need to know which leads deserve attention. Vidapts helps agents capture property enquiries, understand buyer intent, qualify leads with AI, track property interests, manage follow-ups and book appointments — all in one platform. From property enquiry → AI conversation → qualified lead → follow-up → appointment. Built for agents who want a simpler way to turn property interest into real conversations and clients.

records.name: Clarito
records.tagline: Official EU data, not scraped guesses.
records.description: EU cross-border comparison. Tax, residency, and financial data for EU countries. Official data, not AI guesses.

records.name: Fulvid
records.tagline: A standalone desktop editor for Markdown and MDX
records.description: Fulvid is an open source Markdown and MDX editor for open knowledge. Keep your knowledge in portable Markdown files on disk, ready to read, link, reuse, version, and work with across tools and LLM workflows. Search, preview, document links, and Graph navigation stay close to the filesystem. No proprietary vault or cloud workspace.

records.name: ZXN Studio
records.tagline: All-in-one screen recording, editing, and effects for Mac
records.description: ZXN Studio brings screen recording, video editing, background removal and motion into one desktop creative workspace, currently available for Mac.

records.name: RAYXIS Gifts
records.tagline: Create interactive 3D surprise gifts and send them as a link
records.description: Most online gifts are a picture or a PDF. RAYXIS Gifts creates personalized surprise gifts that people can open and play with in the browser: nested gift boxes to unwrap, 3D photo albums to turn page by page, handwritten wax-sealed letters, balloons to pop and cup-guessing games. Create gifts for birthdays, anniversaries, Valentine's Day, Diwali, Raksha Bandhan, weddings and more. Send a link — no app or account needed for the recipient. Most gifts are free; premium designs use credits.

records.name: ReqChain
records.tagline: Stop approving company purchases over WhatsApp
records.description: ReqChain turns scattered purchase requests into one traceable workflow. Anyone submits a request; it moves through the approval levels you define, by role. Attach quotes, then invoices and payment slips, so finance only pays what was actually approved. It also has a supplier side: publish a catalog with today's prices and let your business customers order from it. 14-day free trial, no card required.

records.name: MUN Command Center
records.tagline: Prepare and Manage your Entire MUN on a Single Dashboard.
records.description: MUN Command Center is a local-first toolkit built for Model UN delegates. Keep speeches, country research, POIs, notes, documents, live transcripts, timers, procedure references, and resolutions in one searchable workspace. Run everything on your own computer with no account, telemetry, or cloud database. Optional AI can help analyze research and live committee context, while your preparation stays private. Built for fast access when every few seconds between speeches matters.

records.name: Srcmap
records.tagline: Explore GitHub repos in a VS Code-style workspace
records.description: Explore GitHub code without the setup. Srcmap opens public repositories in a familiar, VS Code-style workspace in your browser. Browse folders, find files, search code, and read with syntax highlighting. Share a link to the exact line or word you want someone to see. Built for developers and students exploring unfamiliar projects, with no cloning or local setup required.

records.name: BikeFit/LAB
records.tagline: Online bikefit
records.description: Get a professional-grade bike fit at home. Film 12 seconds of pedalling; our AI measures nine joint angles and gives millimetre saddle and handlebar advice. Full PDF report from €2.50.

records.name: VOIDRIP
records.tagline: make complexity easy to build
records.description: VOIDRIP turns complex projects into one connected system AI coding agents can actually build from - no scattered docs, no lost context. Built for solo founders in hardware, research, venture or media: it compresses your project to its core logic, tests each stage before you burn capital, and keeps your unique thinking as the source. → Early access is open.

records.name: Lark Text to speech
records.tagline: Text-to-speech tools for creating clear
records.description: TTSLark is a text-to-speech platform designed to convert written material into spoken audio. It can support tasks such as content narration, accessibility, language learning, voice-enabled workflows, and audio production. The service is intended for individuals, teams, and organizations seeking a practical way to generate speech from text without specialized recording equipment. Its use cases may include documents, articles, scripts, educational material, and digital experiences.

records.name: ZEDX AI Interviewer
records.tagline: The AI that interviews you  before the real thing
records.description: ZEDX AI is a voice-native technical interview simulator. Forget scripted chatbots—ZEDX acts as a relentless Senior Tech Lead. It dynamically analyzes your CV, challenges your system design and coding logic in real-time, and provides a brutal performance scorecard to pinpoint your exact weak spots. Powered by multi-LLM routing and sub-second voice latency to simulate a true high-pressure interview environment across 29 languages.

records.name: AppVendorAI
records.tagline: AI CRM for sales, WhatsApp and revenue intelligence
records.description: AppVendorAI is an AI-powered CRM that combines prospecting, sales, WhatsApp, automated follow-up, marketing, AI sales agents and revenue intelligence in one platform. It helps businesses qualify leads, prioritize opportunities, recover inactive leads, automate next actions and manage the entire customer journey from acquisition to post-sale.

records.name: Drape
records.tagline: one shortcut before you share your screen
records.description: One shortcut, pressed a few seconds before you share your screen. The apps you pick are hidden, notification banners are covered, desktop icons cleared. Try to open a hidden app and it won't open at all — you get a cover and a 3-minute snooze instead. Press again and everything comes back exactly as it was. What's different: no Accessibility permission, and no claim to detect screen sharing — macOS has no API for that, so you press the shortcut yourself. Free and open source.

records.name: Ruckus Trivia
records.tagline: Hand-built music trivia for bars, breweries, and events.
records.description: Ruckus Trivia is a music trivia content platform built for bars, breweries, restaurants, and corporate event planners. Each pack includes 25–50 hand-written questions covering a specific genre, decade, or theme — sourced against AllMusic, Billboard, and RIAA data, then fact-checked before publication. Every pack comes with a built-in browser-based presenter for audience display, host notes on every question, print-ready answer sheets, and sequenced playlists on Spotify and Apple Music.

records.name: Financica
records.tagline: Founder-first, AI-native bookkeeping for startups & SMEs
records.description: Financica is a shared finance workspace where founders and accountants collaborate on the same ledger — same screen, same data. Key features: • AI transaction categorization & smart suggestions • Free unlimited Peppol / UBL e-invoicing • Multi-currency books with FX gain/loss tracking • Invoice OCR &eml receipt support • Built-in VAT tracking & compliance reports • Conversational AI to query your live ledger

records.name: FixMyFiles - Free File Converter
records.tagline: That Never Uploads Your File
records.description: FixMyFiles.cc is a lightning-fast, privacy-first file utility platform. Built on zero-JS server architecture, it strips away the heavy ad tracking, slow processing, and paywalls found on legacy file sites—delivering instant conversions and file fixes directly in your browser. 🔒 Privacy-First: Secure, zero-retention file processing designed to keep your data safe. 🚫 Zero Ad Bloat: Clean, minimal UI with no popup traps or hidden countdown timers.

records.name: search intent
records.tagline: Turn YouTube searches into leads
records.description: Get found by people already looking for you. We create 20 YouTube videos around the searches your customers make.

records.name: AbriFit
records.tagline: All-in-one gym management and member retention software
records.description: AbriFit is an all-in-one cloud gym management platform engineered to eliminate operational friction and stop revenue leakage. It automates member onboarding, biometric attendance, GST-compliant invoicing, recurring payment collections, trainer commissions, and scheduling. Built with real-time retention analytics to give fitness entrepreneurs full operational control.

records.name: FixApplianceCode
records.tagline: Decode appliance error codes and fix them faster
records.description: FixApplianceCode is a free lookup tool for homeowners — not a repair shop or forum scrape. What's different: one page per error code with plain-English meaning, numbered fix steps (filter and reset before parts), DIY difficulty score, repair-vs-replace guidance, and compatible MPNs for Samsung, LG, Whirlpool, Bosch, and GE. Browse 500+ guides, symptom hubs (washer won't drain, dryer won't start), or search brand + code. Optional AI diagnosis for obscure codes. No paywall on the core lookup.

records.name: Weave
records.tagline: Private AI journaling that never leaves your phone
records.description: Weave is a journaling app built on one promise: your entries never leave your phone. Speak or write — your voice is transcribed on-device and the audio is deleted, every reflection is generated on your phone, and the whole app works in airplane mode. No account, no cloud, no tracking.

records.name: ImgCutout
records.tagline: Private, free background remover that runs in your browser
records.description: ImgCutout removes image backgrounds entirely in your browser. The AI model runs on your device with WebAssembly, so photos are never uploaded. No sign-up, credits, or watermarks, and results are full resolution. What stands out: • Bulk mode: drop a folder of up to 100 product photos, get Amazon, Shopify, eBay or Etsy-ready images in one ZIP • Auto-centering, shadows, and file-size limits • Brush to fix missed areas, crop, ID-photo sizes

records.name: Afflemi
records.tagline: Afflemi is a directory for both sides of affiliate marketing
records.description: Afflemi is a directory for both sides of affiliate marketing. Publishers and creators browse hundreds of affiliate programs by category, with commission, cookie length and payout terms laid out so you can compare before applying, plus the networks and tools that make promoting easier. Brands find what their program needs to grow: affiliate software, tracking platforms, recruitment tools, influencer marketing platforms and agencies. Plain facts, honest terms, one-time listing fee for vendors.

records.name: SkillGrill
records.tagline: Find AI agent skills that actually work.
records.description: AI agent skills are everywhere—but stars and install counts don’t tell you whether a skill actually does the job. Skill Grill helps developers discover and evaluate agent skills through practical details and firsthand community feedback. Browse skills by category, supported agent, inspect their documentation and included files, review estimated context weight, and see why other developers found them well done or undercooked. Skill Grill is free, open source, and currently in its early MVP stage.

records.name: Our Many Names
records.tagline: Collaborative Family tree building platform
records.description: Our Many Names is a family tree web application with focus on emotional ties rather than getting boxed into traditional bloodlines. We also have a robust testimonial feature to collect stories and anecdotes of loved ones who are no more. We want family trees that tell stories of our ancestors, and not merely building timelines.

records.name: ArcPixel
records.tagline: Turn your work into a portfolio, resume and cover letter.
records.description: Create a portfolio website, bArcPixel helps you build a portfolio website, resume and tailored cover letter in one guided workspace. Import an existing resume or start clean, edit every AI suggestion, preview as you work, and publish or export when ready.uild your resume and write a cover letter with ArcPixel. Start without a card; publishing and PDF export require a plan.

records.name: FCaptcha
records.tagline: Open source invisible CAPTCHA that catches AI agents
records.description: FCaptcha is a self-hosted, MIT-licensed CAPTCHA with no puzzle. One click or fully invisible. It catches headless browsers, Puppeteer, Playwright, Selenium, and the new wave of AI agents driving real browsers (vision click bots, computer-use agents). Verifies Web Bot Auth signed crawlers so polite agents get through. Drop-in for Turnstile, reCAPTCHA and hCaptcha: same siteverify contract. No cookies, no third-party data. WCAG 2.2 AA, false-positive budget enforced in CI. Go, Node or Python.

records.name: Aldea HQ
records.tagline: One home for your community — with payments built-in
records.description: Most community tools stop at chat and files. Aldea HQ is one branded home for your community — an announcements feed, a searchable handbook, a member directory, and support tickets — with Aldea Pay, dues and one-time payment collection built in on every plan via Stripe. Members pay exactly what's owed; the org absorbs the fee. Built for HOAs, condo associations, self-managed neighborhoods, homeschool co-ops, and clubs. Flat pricing from $49/mo and a 14-day free trial; no credit card.

records.name: Ecomprompt
records.tagline: AI prompt generator for e-commerce stores & sellers
records.description: EcomPrompt is an AI prompt generator built for e-commerce sellers & marketers. Instead of generic AI outputs, get tailored prompts to craft high-converting product descriptions, ad copy, and SEO content in seconds. Key benefits: - Optimized e-commerce prompt templates - Conversion-focused copy generation - Save hours on catalog management Boost your online sales and streamline your content strategy effortlessly!

records.name: KeyInOut
records.tagline: Track business keys without spreadsheets or paper
records.description: KeyInOut replaces spreadsheets, handwritten lists, and paper receipts with simple digital key management. Track who has each key, use QR codes for fast checkouts and returns, collect digital signatures, and automatically create PDF receipts. Every handover is recorded for full traceability. No special hardware is needed — just your existing keys, QR labels, and a phone, tablet, or computer.

records.name: Bubblai
records.tagline: Compose characters and AI agents with visual modules
records.description: Bubblai turns an AI agent’s mind into a visible, modular canvas. Instead of hiding everything inside one large prompt or a complex workflow, you connect bubbles for personality, instructions, memory, documents, voice, web access, media, tools and actions. Each ability can be seen, tested and removed. Build specialised assistants, carefully crafted companions, role-playing characters or agentic systems while keeping control of the models and modules they use.

records.name: CV Score
records.tagline: Know exactly where your CV stands, before recruiters do
records.description: CV Score tells you what is wrong with your CV before you send it. Upload a PDF and get a free assessment across 8 professional categories, computed from 48 criteria: header, summary, experience, education, skills, layout, language and ATS readiness. The free result shows a verdict, a percentile, a traffic-light band per category and your highest-impact problem. The one-time Fix Report adds 0-100 scores, every finding and rewritten before/after passages plus a re-scan.

records.name: NiceTryGPT
records.tagline: Make CTFs harder to shortcut with LLMs, not humans
records.description: NiceTryGPT is an open-source minimal-diff workflow that helps CTF authors reduce cheap LLM shortcuts while preserving the intended vulnerability, learning objective, and human experience.

records.name: Luhnify
records.tagline: Fast, Zero-PII API for ID & Passport validation.
records.description: Luhnify is a Zero-PII REST API for instant identity document, VAT, and ICAO 9303 passport checksum validation. Supporting 200+ countries with <100ms latency, it allows developers to implement compliant onboarding and KYC flows without storing sensitive user data.

records.name: Recounts
records.tagline: Your Past, in a Story
records.description: Calm, private daily accomplishment journal. One line a day — kept verbatim — weeks, months and years become your story. Free forever, ad-free.

records.name: ReconAlert — Attack Surface Monitoring
records.tagline: Find the security holes in your vibecoded app before hackers
records.description: You shipped an app fast with Cursor, Lovable, Bolt or v0 — but AI code generators leave real holes: a Stripe key in your JS bundle, a Supabase table with no Row-Level Security, an open Firebase database. ReconAlert scans your live app for exactly these — it reads your actual JS bundle (not the empty shell a URL scanner sees), tests whether your Supabase RLS actually protects your data, and finds leaked keys, each with the one-line fix. Free to start.

records.name: GatherQuill
records.tagline: Capture, organize, and export web research locally
records.description: GatherQuill is a free, local-first Chrome extension for capturing and organizing web research. Highlight text, capture and annotate screenshots, organize findings into projects, and export everything as Markdown. Your data stays in your browser, and no account is required.

records.name: Calphant
records.tagline: A team of AI employees for your whole company
records.description: Turn an idea into a company. Calphant is the platform that takes an idea, or a product, and builds the company around it. AI employees do the work: build, market, sell and support. You stay in charge. Ten frontier models work together as a team, with monthly limits equal to five frontier lab subscriptions. Every decision and outcome stays on the record. Start with one team and one objective. Paid pilots available.

records.name: Paralight
records.tagline: Find where to travel, stay, and live deeply in China
records.description: Paralight is an AI-driven China travel decision platform. Compare 100+ evidence-backed places, explore curated routes, and solve arrival tasks—from visa-free transit and payments to eSIMs and trains. Free to explore; one Pass unlocks full depth for life.

records.name: Kanten
records.tagline: Turn requirements into reviewable, traceable test cases
records.description: Kanten helps QA teams turn requirements into reviewable, traceable test cases. Maintain a shared library of testing perspectives, such as boundaries, permissions, and unstable networks, and apply the relevant ones to each function. Design cases manually or with AI assistance, then review, edit, and export them. Available in English and Japanese.

records.name: Yuka Finance
records.tagline: Market intelligence for traders and investors
records.description: Yuka Finance brings fragmented market data into one clear intelligence platform. Track gamma exposure, institutional COT positioning, market regime, sentiment, seasonality, Fed expectations and the proprietary Yuka Score — built to help traders and long-term investors understand what is actually moving the market.

records.name: Argos Paws
records.tagline: Free calculators & breed guides for dog owners
records.description: Argos Paws gives dog owners 5 free, science-based tools: a puppy weight predictor, food cost calculator, pet insurance calculator, breed-adjusted age calculator, and a breed match quiz. Plus 27 breed guides and practical articles on cost, feeding, and insurance — all backed by veterinary and WSAVA data. No signup required.

records.name: Voice to Text : AI Minutes APP
records.tagline: Ai Summary & Meeting Notes
records.description: Most voice apps hand you a transcript. This one hands you a document: overview, key points, decisions and action items, with timestamps you tap to jump to that moment. Then it keeps working. Chat with any recording, or turn it into flashcards and a 10-question quiz built from your own words. Transcription runs on-device, so your audio never leaves your phone. And when something isn't in the recording, it says so instead of inventing an answer.

records.name: PostWeavers
records.tagline: AI drafts your X replies in your voice. It never posts.
records.description: PostWeavers drafts X replies that sound like you: a voice profile learned from your posts, topics built one saved post at a time, and a humanizer that strips AI tells. It never auto-posts, never DMs, never sees your feed. Open source. Free with your own key.

records.name: ClassPanel
records.tagline: Free, no-signup timers & tools for class, study, life
records.description: Most classroom/timer tools bury simple actions behind ads, forced sign-ups, or cluttered dashboards. ClassPanel is the opposite: 17+ free tools — timers, random pickers, group generators, dice, coin flips, and more — that load instantly and work with zero account required. Every tool fullscreen-ready for projectors. Built from real search-demand data, not guesswork, so it serves teachers, students studying solo, and anyone who just needs a quick.

records.name: L&M Fsat Reversal Engine™
records.tagline: Candle-close signals for disciplined stock reversals
records.description: 🚨 ONE-MONTH FREE TRIAL OF THE L&M FAST REVERSAL ENGINE™! 🚨 A TradingView indicator for active stock and options traders using candle-close confirmation, market structure, momentum, volume, ADX and VWAP to highlight potential reversal and continuation setups. Market-state filters and an adaptive trail help filter lower-quality conditions.

records.name: LifeContext AI
records.tagline: An AI companion that works in airplane mode
records.description: LifeContext AI is an AI companion for Android — chat, voice, and memory — that runs entirely on your phone. No account, no server, no telemetry. Download a model once (~1.3-3 GB), then use it anywhere, even in airplane mode. Your conversations never leave your device.

records.name: Camena
records.tagline: GPS audio tours that play as you explore
records.description: Explore Victoria and Vancouver Island with stories that play automatically as you follow a walking, cycling, or driving route. Download tour audio before you go, then explore at your own pace. Start with the free Inner Harbour walk; more tours are available to buy. For iPhone and Android.

records.name: Link Mahal
records.tagline: Digital menu and WhatsApp store for restaurants & sellers
records.description: Digital menu Lebanon and AI-powered WhatsApp store for restaurants and sellers. Create a QR menu with WhatsApp checkout — flat plans from $5/mo, $0 commission. COD, Whish Pay card checkout, bilingual EN/AR, Instagram bio links.

records.name: Home Affordability Index
records.tagline: See the income needed to buy a home in 30 US cities
records.description: The Coinscribed Home Affordability Index ranks 30 major US metros by the household income you'd need to afford the median home under the 28% rule. Every number is computed from clear assumptions — 20% down, 30-year fixed, plus taxes and insurance — using the same math as our mortgage calculator. Free, no signup. Built to help buyers and renters see where owning a home is realistically within reach.

records.name: CorroScan
records.tagline: Detect and measure corrosion with your iPhone Pro
records.description: Inspect corrosion with on-device AI and LiDAR. CorroScan outlines rust patches, measures their area and span, and saves geotagged records. Pro adds unlimited scans and PDF defect reports. Standalone inspection works offline; Teams adds cloud sync and a web dashboard. First 100 scans free. Available in six languages. Requires a LiDAR-equipped iPhone.

records.name: FALLMATCH
records.tagline: Logic block puzzle with gravity. Play free in your browser.
records.description: FALLMATCH is a logic block puzzle with gravity. Slide a block left or right; matching patterns clear when they touch. Rotate or flip the board and gravity does the rest. Every board has a proven best solution: the 3-star target is the real minimum, found by a solver before it shipped. 400 campaign levels, a 10-rung ladder, one daily board for everyone. No timer, no lives, no ads, no account. Play free in your browser, or get it on iOS and Android. Optional one-time Premium, no subscriptions.

records.name: App Launch OS
records.tagline: Audit your mobile app UI/UX, growth & avoid rejection
records.description: App Launch OS is the all-in-one open-source repo for Expo & React Native. Audit Apple & Google store rejection traps, fix your UI/UX with 12 cognitive laws, and drop in compliant paywalls, haptics, and growth experiments in seconds.

records.name: CadenceOne
records.tagline: 1-to-1s for managers. No recording, no account, no cloud.
records.description: CadenceOne is a native macOS app to prepare, run and follow up on your 1-to-1s. One thread per person, not one document per meeting: past meetings, still-open topics, the promises you owe, development goals, wins worth remembering. Open someone's page thirty seconds before the meeting and you have the context. No recording, no transcription, no account for your team, no cloud. Everything stays on your Mac. 14-day trial, then a one-time 59 €. No subscription.

records.name: JuryVision
records.tagline: Rehearse in front of an AI jury before you face a real one.
records.description: JuryVision lets trial attorneys rehearse any argument or presentation in front of an AI jury before the real one hears it. Unlike tools that just grade a transcript, it watches your actual delivery: body language, pacing, eye contact, energy. 14 distinct juror personas, each biased differently, react individually to your performance. A senior Jury Consultant then turns those reactions into one scored, actionable report, with specific rewrites for exactly what isn't landing yet.

records.name: AdSpire Systems
records.tagline: Plug-and-play AI prompts for agency client acquisition
records.description: The AI Client Prompt Playbook is a 6-section PDF of prompt structures for the stages of getting and keeping a client: lead gen, cold outreach, discovery, proposals, objection handling, and onboarding. Each section follows the same format: the problem, the exact prompt, why it works, and a before/after example. Built for agency owners, freelancers, media buyers, and consultants who want to stop writing everything from scratch. Works with any AI chat tool. $29, instant download.

records.name: Cantya
records.tagline: It answers. It understands. It responds.
records.description: Cantya is an AI-powered virtual receptionist that handles calls 24/7 for medical practices, real estate, and customer service teams. It books appointments, qualifies leads, answers common questions — all in French, English, Spanish, German, or Italian. Integrates seamlessly with your calendar and CRM. No setup complexity. No missed calls. Used by clinics, agencies, and service teams. Never lose revenue because nobody picked up the phone. 14 days free, no card.

records.name: GridDash
records.tagline: Start page, bookmarks, and a desktop command centre
records.description: GridDash is a free tile start page and bookmark manager. Set it as your homepage. The desktop app is a command centre too — launch apps, run system commands, control OBS, plus widgets and actions on the same grid. Share a layout and anyone can copy it. Built solo; feedback welcome.

records.name: Ieltsa
records.tagline: Free IELTS practice tests, mock exams and study plans
records.description: Ieltsa offers free, month-dated IELTS listening and reading practice rebuilt from test-taker recalls, with recreated audio, transcripts, answer keys and explanations. Explore writing and speaking resources, study plans, a free course and timed mock exams. Core practice needs no registration. Independent study resource; not official IELTS exam papers.

records.name: NaraOps
records.tagline: Turn operational spreadsheets into management decisions
records.description: Turn CSV and Excel exports into clear management insights. NaraOps learns your fields, connects related tables with reviewed relationships, and surfaces changes, drivers and risks. Generate audience-specific briefs and ask questions grounded in calculated evidence. Spreadsheet rows are analysed in your browser; document extraction is optional and reviewed before use. Try the business examples without an account, or start a 14-day free trial.

records.name: HolidayHub Elite

records.description: Holiday Hub Elite is a collaborative trip planner that brings everything your group needs into one place. Manage shared expenses, organize activities, create polls, share photos and check the weather without juggling multiple apps. Available as a lightweight Progressive Web App, it works on almost any device with no installation required.

records.name: Free Comments
records.tagline: Turn more visitors into leads with AI-powered engagement.
records.description: Drop in a simple code snippet and transform your website with AI-powered chat, comments, reviews and surveys. Choose our FREE plan, or upgrade to ad-free for less than a pint!

records.name: LochNest

records.description: LochNest is a lightweight Windows app for managing products, stock movements, categories, suppliers, reports, and backups in one place. Everything stays on your PC, with no cloud dependency or monthly subscription. I built it for small businesses and solo makers who want a clear, practical inventory tool that gets out of the way. Try the demo and tell me what works—and what should improve.

records.name: Folioshift
records.tagline: See what a trade does to your portfolio before you place it
