Enter your holdings, simulate a trade — sell one position, buy another — and see the instant before/after impact on weighting, sector exposure, and concentration. Not a tracker, not a robo-advisor: a structural "what if" tool for people who already manage their own stock-picking portfolio.

records.name: MagicFlow AI – AI Chatbot
records.tagline: AI chatbot for Indian SMEs. 2-hour setup, 30-day free trial
records.description: MagicFlow AI: RAG-based AI chatbot SaaS for Indian SMEs. Real-time lead qualification, 30+ languages, CRM integrations, DPDP Act compliant, free trial.

records.name: Focus Flow
records.tagline: A quiet, local-first Pomodoro companion
records.description: A quiet Pomodoro timer with procedural Web Audio soundscapes, 5 sensory themes (WCAG AAA), and 100% client-side data sovereignty. No accounts, no subscriptions, no tracking, and zero guilt streaks. Just open and focus.

records.name: TrackTheHabit
records.tagline: Create, customize & print habit trackers for free
records.description: TrackTheHabit is a free online habit tracker that lets you create, customize, print, and save habit trackers as PDFs. Choose daily, weekly, or monthly layouts, add your own habits, and personalize the style. It also includes 126 free printable templates, including weekly, monthly, 30-day, yearly, minimalist, pastel, dark mode, streak, circle, and bullet-journal-inspired designs. No sign-up, email, or watermark.

records.name: Tanvelo
records.tagline: Test your AI. Find its weaknesses. Fix it
records.description: Tanvelo tests your AI chatbot / RAG / coding assistant with 100s of auto-generated tests, gives you a 0-100 Health Score, clusters failures, finds root causes, and generates training data to fix it

records.name: Postural
records.tagline: Two photos turn your posture into one number you can track
records.description: Postural takes a front and a side photo, measures your posture on the device with Apple's Vision framework, and turns it into a Postural Age: your real age plus a penalty of up to 8 years. It measures five markers and scores only the two with published evidence behind them. The other three are shown and count zero. A licensed physiotherapist reviewed the routines, the form cues and the scoring thresholds. Photos never leave your phone. The scan, the number and the coach note are free.

records.name: CalPal
records.tagline: Say it in plain English, keep the calculator.
records.description: Type a sentence and get a working sheet: named values you can edit, clock times and real timezones, ratios and units that cancel. Change one number and everything below it recomputes. Copy it out with its answers, or share it as a page.

records.name: Vireo - Simple Markdown Editor for MacOS
records.tagline: Free and open source. Your files never leave your computer.
records.description: Vireo is a simple, fast, free, native macOS markdown editor, built in Swift. The markdown syntax is beautifully hidden. Files and folders live on your disk no vaults, no plugins, no drama. - 100% free, MIT open source - 100% local — no account, no cloud, no vaults - Native Mac app: tabs, ⌘P quick open, workspace sidebar, table of contents, focus mode - GFM tables with a native cell editor, floating format toolbar - Quick Look extension for Finder - Requires macOS 15+

records.name: AI SpendOps
records.tagline: Reduce your AI spend with detailed monitoring
records.description: Your multi-provider invoices arrive as one number nobody can explain. AI SpendOps is a managed gateway that prices every LLM call as it happens and attributes it to the team, feature or customer that caused it. Unlike tracing tools, it is built for cost accounting, not debugging, and it never stores prompts or responses. Point your SDK at it, add one header, keep your own keys. Budgets with email alerts flag runaway spend early.

records.name: ERLİK
records.tagline: Activity & focus intelligence for developers, 100% local
records.description: ERLİK tracks where your time actually goes on a Mac — which apps, which projects, which git branch — and keeps every byte on your machine. No account, no telemetry, no cloud. Pure Swift for Apple Silicon: a menubar widget, a local dashboard on port 5757, and a clipboard history with pinnable boards. Two Macs sync directly over Tailscale/SSH, never through a third party. For developers who want a tracker's insight without handing their activity to someone else's server.

records.name: MoonMan
records.tagline: Escape a collapsing moon mine using gravity & oxygen. 🧑‍🚀
records.description: One thumb is all it takes to save Earth. Inspired by Tiny Wings, MoonMan is a minimalist gravity escape game originally storyboarded in 2013. Launch off the rock to escape a massive moon mine collapse and maneuver to the surface using oxygen as your only resource. Your jumps and movements are deeply musical, dynamically building the soundtrack as you play. Can you make it out alive? If you fail, the Moon loses its orbit and plummets toward Earth. Beta web app v0.0.3.0 is live! 👨‍🚀💎🙌

records.name: Copywise
records.tagline: AI-powered cold emails that get replies. Write 10x faster.
records.description: Generate high-converting cold emails, social posts, ad copy, and more with AI. Start free, upgrade when you need unlimited generations.

records.name: IronPack
records.tagline: The gym tracker where your workouts earn trading cards
records.description: Train. Collect. Compete. IronPack is a gym tracker - sets, reps, PBs, progression - with a trading card game built on top. Log your training, earn packs, rip them open. Everything is earned. No ads, no card purchases, no shortcuts. Weekly leagues and friend boards rank you on what you actually lift. Every card is researched and fact-checked, so collecting doubles as a way into learning about Greek gods, and strongman history (our first collections). 213 cards live, built by one person in NZ.

records.name: Spelio
records.tagline: Plan where your money will go, before you spend it.
records.description: Spelio is a budgeting app built for planning ahead, not just tracking the past. Organize income and expenses month by month, see your projected balance, manage recurring costs, set savings goals and build your wishlist. Spelio helps you understand how today's decisions can affect the months ahead, with a simple interface designed to make future spending easier to plan.

records.name: PotholeScan
records.tagline: Measure potholes in 3D with your iPhone Pro
records.description: Turn an iPhone Pro into a road inspection tool. On-device AI and LiDAR measure pothole depth, area and fill volume, with 3D models, GPS records and PDF/CSV exports. Standalone scans work offline. First 100 scans free; Pro adds unlimited scans and watermark-free reports. Requires a LiDAR-equipped iPhone.

records.name: Lingua Playlist
records.tagline: Learn languages through your own sentences
records.description: Stop memorizing textbook phrases you'll never use. Lingua Playlist lets you build a personal language library from sentences you actually encounter in conversations, TV, books, podcasts, travel, or work. Organize them into playlists, turn them into audio lessons, practice pronunciation, and review with spaced repetition. AI helps with translations and sentence suggestions, while you stay in control of what you learn.

records.name: Rustly
records.tagline: See where coding agents spend tokens, context and money.
records.description: Rustly records every request Claude Code, Codex and Cursor make to their providers and shows exactly where your tokens, context window and money go. Find the turn that broke your prompt cache, the tool schemas nobody calls, and the work done twice. Runs entirely on your machine. $99, one payment.

records.name: K-Scan AI K-Beauty
records.tagline: Scan K-Beauty products at Olive Young & see what fits you
records.description: Generic scan apps just translate text. K-Scan AI is a camera-first K-Beauty companion: point it at any Korean package at Olive Young to identify the exact product, see the ingredient list explained in plain language (no fear-based good/bad scores), and view it in the context of your saved skin profile - so you can judge fit before the register. Localized INCI breakdowns go beyond literal translation. Built for K-Beauty shoppers and Korea travelers.

records.name: Lilac Cabture
records.tagline: Smart Taxi Dispatch & Fleet Management Software
records.description: Cabture is a taxi dispatch and fleet management software designed to help taxi companies and transportation businesses manage bookings, drivers, passengers, vehicles, and daily operations from one platform. It supports digital booking, automated dispatching, real-time tracking, driver management, and fleet operations, helping businesses streamline their transportation services and deliver a better customer experience.

records.name: DriveDex
records.tagline: Pokémon GO for cars — scan it, collect it, complete the dex
records.description: DriveDex turns everyday car-spotting into a game. Point your camera at any car, and AI identifies the make, model, and trim in seconds — then adds it to your personal Dex. Every car you scan gets logged in your virtual garage. Track your collection, hunt down rare finds, climb the leaderboard, and try to complete the full Dex — from daily drivers to unicorn hypercars. This is built solo as a passion project, so every comment genuinely shapes the roadmap.

records.name: Kick VOD & Clips Downloader
records.tagline: Fast, free Kick VOD & Clips downloader in HD MP4.
records.description: Download Kick livestreams and clips directly to your device in perfect HD MP4 format. No watermarks, no registration, and no display ads. Built to automatically fix rawts files so your downloads are instantly ready for Premiere Pro or CapCut.

records.name: Plane Agents
records.tagline: Assign work to AI agents, like any teammate
records.description: Plane Agents join your workspace as members. Assign them work items, tag them, trigger them when work changes, or run them on a schedule. They triage requests, draft specs, run standups, flag delivery risks and a lot more. Agents run on the AI credits included in every paid plan.

records.name: Ballast
records.tagline: Hyper-V control plane that keeps working offline
records.description: Ballast is a control plane and agent for Hyper-V hosts and failover clusters. The agent runs on each host and keeps enforcing its last-known-good config if the centre goes offline, catching back up automatically once reachable again. Community edition is free forever for one cluster of any size plus unlimited standalone hosts. The agent is open source (Apache 2.0); the centre is closed source. Built primarily with Claude Code under my direction, tested against real Hyper-V hosts and clusters.

records.name: OnlyChatAI
records.tagline: AI that runs fan chats on OnlyFans and Telegram
records.description: OnlyChatAI runs fan conversations for creator agencies, natively inside OnlyFans and Telegram. It chats in character 24/7, sells PPV content through scripted funnels with Telegram Stars support, and re-engages fans who go quiet.

records.name: CAELVO
records.tagline: traveling, flight, cheap flight
records.description: Find cheaper flights by comparing airports within driving distance of your home. CAELVO is a flight search tool that starts with where you live instead of asking you to choose a departure airport first. Enter your home location, destination and how far you’re willing to drive. CAELVO finds airports within your driving range, checks available flights and compares the options by flight price and driving time.

records.name: Biogistry
records.tagline: Client-Side Clinical Genetics & Pedigree Workbench
records.description: Biogistry is a 100% client-side, browser-native clinical genetics workbench. Core Features: • Intake to Pedigree, Punnett and Idiogram: ACMG 4-pass auto-layout, GEDCOM & FHIR R4 import/export • Custom Risk Engine Dev: Build risk models, Bayesian carrier math & curves • Analysis Suite: 10+ risk models and 17+ genetic calculations • Free-Form Report Builder: Custom rich-text clinical report synthesis • P2P Collaboration: Zero-knowledge sharing in a multi-sheet workspace

records.name: BizWax.AI
records.tagline: The AI toolbox for founders and small businesses
records.description: Bizwax.ai is a growing AI toolbox for founders, small businesses, and entrepreneurs. Validate an idea with MOAT Evaluator, practice sales with Sales Trainer, and chat across every model with BizChat. What's different: bring your own API keys and the provider bills you directly, no markup, or use included credits. Everything you make saves to one Library.

records.name: Gemut Health
records.tagline: Build your own health
records.description: Gemut reads your blood work, explains what stands behind it, and turns it into a personal plan — for body and mind. 78+ markers, AI companion Noa, iOS and web.

records.name: phras.ai

records.description: A writing studio that turns machine drafts into natural prose in 7 languages (English and Russian fully; Spanish, Portuguese, German, French and Polish in beta). Word-level diff, protected code blocks and tables, Markdown export. 500 free words, no card required. No detector promises — just clearer writing in your own voice.

records.name: onGST Calculator

records.name: Fine Print Guard-- Instant Tos + privacy

records.name: OpinRate

records.name: HI, DEVELOPER!

Designed to keep your desk clean and your mind organized before typing a single line of code.

records.name: VaaniTTS

records.description: Drishti AI Tools Studio - Next-gen Hindi & English & Also 16+ Indian Languages Text-to-Speech models, REST API, and audio synthesis tools.

records.name: Alucava

records.description: Pastely is a macOS menu bar app. Copy anything, press one hotkey, and it turns what you copied into the format the app you are pasting into needs.

records.name: MiniPNG

records.description: MiniPNG has 52 tools for images and PDFs that run in your browser: compress, convert, merge, split, rotate, strip metadata. records.name: HeyGarçon

No sign-up needed. Try it.

records.description: Noctessa is nightclub reservation software with a live floor plan: guests pick a table online, staff seat and check them in from a phone. 7-day trial, €39/mo.

records.name: BingeMark: Movie, TV & Anime Tracker

records.name: Smash Haters
records.tagline: **Use your fists. Knock out haters. Burn fat. 🥊🔥
records.description: **Smash Haters turns your rage into a workout. 🥊🔥😏 Punch your toxic ex, annoying boss, awful customers, or anyone living rent-free in your head. Your camera tracks your punches and turns them into hits, scores, and calories burned. No controller. No VR. No gym. Just open your camera and start swinging. 🔥Stress out. Sweat it out. Smash your haters🔥

records.name: CV Maker Free
records.tagline: Free CV & Resume Maker, no signup needed, ATS Score checker
records.description: Use free CV maker & build a free CV online in minutes. Ten ATS-friendly templates including Europass, an instant quality score, and PDF. No sign-up needed.

records.name: MemoryLane
records.tagline: See what tasks you repeat and how to automate them
records.description: Desktop app that logs your daily tasks as you work locally on-device, uses AI to spot what you often repeat and suggests how to automate it. Use it to feed n8n, Zapier or any other tool new automation ideas so you don't have to think about it.

records.name: Kulawise
records.tagline: Gamifying healthy living
records.description: The infrastructure to build, grow, and monetize your wellness business. Kulawise gives fitness coaches, gyms, nutritionists, and wellness creators the tools to build community, engage members, and monetize with recurring revenue.

records.name: Sidewise
records.tagline: What is the other side reading?
records.description: Sidewise pulls feeds from 14 newsrooms across the spectrum, tags each left, center or right, and shows you the same day from every angle. Reader plus a free API. Free on Mac.

records.name: World Explorer
records.tagline: 3D World Map & Location Guesser Game
records.description: Explore Earth in 3D with real terrain and satellite imagery, or play 3D Location Guesser — get dropped anywhere on the planet and guess where you are.

records.name: NovaPeakBloom
records.tagline: Understand markets through structured learning
records.description: Our platform is designed to make financial market education easier to understand and more accessible, especially for beginners. We focus on clear explanations, structured learning, and practical market concepts without unnecessary complexity. Users can learn at their own pace and build a stronger understanding of how markets work before making their own decisions.

records.name: SkedCast
records.tagline: Bulk social scheduling built for agencies
records.description: Compose once, publish to many connected accounts. SkedCast paces every account separately and alerts you the moment a platform refuses a post. LinkedIn, Facebook and YouTube are live; more networks are rolling out. REST API and MCP server included.

records.name: TubeCheckers
records.tagline: All-in-one free toolkit for YouTube creators & analytics
records.description: TubeCheckers is a 100% free, high-speed toolkit built for YouTube creators, marketers, and researchers. Instantly verify channel monetization status, calculate estimated AdSense revenue, audit channel SEO, extract hidden video tags, track real-time live subscriber counts, and generate optimized titles & descriptions—with zero forced logins or paywalls.

records.name: Bulk Image Download
records.tagline: Paste any URL, get every image — no extension
records.description: Paste a webpage URL and Bulk Image Download finds the images on it in your browser. Preview results in a grid, filter by size or dimensions, remove duplicates, rename selected files, and download everything you want as one ZIP. Built for collecting product photos, article visuals, gallery assets, and other page images without manually saving files one by one.

records.name: KimoShell
records.tagline: Server monitoring and SSH terminals, side by side
records.description: A lightweight SSH workspace for one server or many. See CPU, memory, disk, network and processes, then open an interactive terminal with key stats in view. No remote KimoShell agent to install.

records.name: Otto
records.tagline: CarPlay dashboard widgets — one payment, no subscription
records.description: Otto fills your CarPlay dashboard with widgets that belong there: a clock in five faces, your license plate, countdowns to inspection and insurance, fuel economy, and where you parked. Built for the car screen specifically — CarPlay strips a widget's background, so Otto's widgets paint their own and stay readable. Contrast is measured, not eyeballed. A welcome sound plays when CarPlay connects; your parking spot is saved when it disconnects. Free. Pro is one payment, not a subscription.

records.name: SHINELAND™ Focus
records.tagline: A timer for focused work and planned breaks
records.description: SHINELAND Focus is a browser-based timer that alternates focused work with planned breaks. Choose 15-, 20-, or 30-minute work sessions and 5- or 10-minute breaks. Give each mode its own background audio, add an optional transition sound, and use pause, reset, or skip controls. No account or installation required.

records.name: LogFrog
records.tagline: Production monitoring that ranks what needs fixing today
records.description: LogFrog is the production operator for founder-led SaaS. One script tag captures errors, session replays, analytics, web vitals and support chat; npm or Go packages add logs, traces and server monitoring. Instead of nine dashboards, Autopilot ranks it all into one daily list: "Fix TypeError X — 42 users in 24h", "14 sessions dead-clicked Pricing". Ranking is arithmetic, not AI. Drop-in for Sentry SDKs, MCP access for Claude Code and Cursor, iOS app for alerts. 30-day trial, no card, from $29/mo.

records.name: OneGrowthRise
records.tagline: Tools, insights, and support in one place
records.description: OneGrowthRise is a digital platform focused on providing users with access to market tools, analytical information, and online support in one structured environment. The platform emphasizes usability, clear navigation, and technology designed to make complex information easier to understand. Its services are aimed at users with different levels of experience, combining digital tools, market insights, and personalized assistance within a single online experience.

records.name: PTT Football
records.tagline: Plan your entire football matchday in one place
records.description: PTT Football puts the entire matchday in one place. Covering all 92 Premier League and EFL clubs, fans choose a fixture and build their day around it — with home, away and mixed pubs, trains, parking, hotels, taxis, stadium, entry and accessibility information. Save your matchday and keep the journey together instead of jumping between multiple sites and apps. Available free on iOS, Android and web. Built by football fans, for football fans.

records.name: Page to Image - Screenshots & PDF
records.tagline: A screenshot extension that I wanted for myself
records.description: Capture full webpages, crop and annotate the result, then export as PNG, JPEG, or PDF. Captures and edits stay local in your browser.

records.name: Luney
records.tagline: Somewhere to be yourself, on purpose.
records.description: Luney is an 18+ LGBTQIA+ social and community app for making friends, joining queer communities, discovering events and connecting through group chats and live audio rooms. Free on iOS and Android.

records.name: The Fullstack Creators
records.tagline: The Talent marketplace.
records.description: Connect with talented students for web development, design, and creative projects. Find skilled developers, designers, and creators, or post your project today.

records.name: Whisperto
records.tagline: The meeting copilot only you can see
records.description: Whisperto listens to both sides of your call and writes the line to say next — the actual question, using their numbers, not "consider discussing pricing". The panel is excluded from macOS screen capture, so it never shows up in a screen share. Nothing joins the call: no bot, no participant, nobody is notified. Ask it anything mid-call; it answers from the live transcript. Hang up and it writes the debrief. Everything stays on your Mac.
